description: An MMA fighter's record (wins, losses, draws, no contests; wins and losses by KO/TKO, submission, decision) from the bouts held since 2026, with the last fights; where Wikipedia/Wikidata has the fighter also the profile (birth date, height, reach, stance, nationality, weight class, team), the career record and the fights before 2026 (cite the attribution). Or find fighters by name.

fighter_id.description: fighter code (or number) from a bout: the record, recent fights, profile and history

name.description: part of a fighter's name, to find the id

name: get_mma_fighter
